items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury and limited/no practice; Rams optimistic after feeling better Saturday.
items.why: Schefter official active + ETR GTD-optimism + Rap/Berry confirmation; McVay called minor.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; reverse any bench/sit plans.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; high snap share vs LV.

items.text: Breece Hall officially INACTIVE vs Dolphins; unlikely after limited practice returning from quad, sources said early then confirmed.
items.why: Rap pregame unlikely + official inactive; Schefter listed inactive; ETR GTD-pess. Missed prior 3.
items.implication: Sit; handcuff/backup elevated for full workload in good matchup.
items.opportunity: Backup RB (Allen-type) snaps/carries/routes spike; Jets RB1 opportunity.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals after high-ankle sprain; previously Q. Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: ETR weekend summary + Schefter/Rap corrob on downgrade from Q; missed prior two games.
items.implication: Ravens QB downgrade; Huntley streamer but limited upside. Monitor Week 8 return optimism.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps/red-zone; Ravens pass game volume may drop.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield in snap share (50%), rush share (41%), route participation (34%); Dobbins only 21% snaps.
items.why: Berry per-player Love with snap/rush/route lead post-IR return; prior endorsement.
items.implication: Coleman the Broncos RB to roster/own ROS; Dobbins downgrade.
items.opportunity: Coleman lead early-down/3rd down; goal-line still contested.
items.conflict: Dobbins got goal-line TD but low overall share.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; on ETR watch after purposeful slide attempt.
items.why: Levitan player-specific take post ETR injury watch.
items.implication: Monitor status; potential role reduction if limited.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, Tracy or backups gain carries/snaps.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would be tilting if serious from smart non-score.
items.why: Levitan direct on ETR watch list; purposeful slide context.
items.implication: No downgrade; continue as RB1. Monitor practice.
items.opportunity: Full workload continues; Lions backfield stable.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring Q).
items.why: ETR summary of weekend reports; Smith hamstring, Wicks related. Saquon expected.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thinned; Saquon start if active. Beneficiaries in remaining pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes to Goedert, other WRs; Saquon full role if clears.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated and expected to play; listed IN with other returns like Mason, Dell, Coleman, Kirk.
items.why: Schefter activations list + ETR IN; returning for Packers.
items.implication: Upgrade to RB1/2 role; monitor snap share post-return.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries/red-zone; Packers RB hierarchy reset.

items.text: Seahawks opening Jadarian Price 21-day practice window this week; eligible return Week 8. Charbonnet still on plan, not confirmed vs Bears.
items.why: Schefter + Rap/Macdonald; Levitan notes suitors context for JT but Price help.
items.implication: Potential RB depth add for SEA; monitor activation.
items.opportunity: If returns, shares with Walker/others; stash in deep leagues.

items.text: Nico Collins led Texans with 24 routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 (return game), Noel 15 (left early turf toe).
items.why: Levitan post-game routes; Dell limited first game since 2024.
items.implication: Nico clear WR1 alpha; Dell handcuff/depth only short-term.
items.opportunity: Collins high route/target share; Dell low involvement.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant; source describes as day-to-day.
items.why: Schefter primary source post Vikings win.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 8; limited missed time expected. Monitor practice.

items.text: Seahawks, Broncos, Vikings, Packers potential suitors for Jonathan Taylor ahead of Nov 10 deadline; Price window opens as SEA weapon need beyond JSN.
items.why: Levitan on Schefter trade names video; Price status unsure but eligible W8.
items.implication: JT trade value/ROS landing spot watch; SEA RB depth contingency.
items.opportunity: If JT moves, new team role expansion; Price stash.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game w/o Rice); high volume but never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.why: Levitan route data; ceiling note despite opportunity.
items.implication: Volume spike but efficiency/ceiling capped; WR2/flex with Rice out.
items.opportunity: Lead routes/targets in KC; red-zone limited historically.
items.conflict: High routes vs low historical ceiling.

items.text: Garrett Wilson 29 routes, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 13 tgts season), AD Mitchell 18 on 33 Geno dropbacks with Mitchell back.
items.why: Levitan routes + Cooper efficiency note (30th pick, limited prior routes).
items.implication: Wilson still lead; Cooper emerging efficiency play/stash.
items.opportunity: Wilson high routes; Cooper target efficiency upside.
